dependencies.quack: Requires a clean checkout at 77a750c0d9548d4a6e23c0f64062d61b3ea420ff; package version is insufficient

protocol.same_address_replays: normal A, outlier B, exact A-return, sparse, zero; before and after
protocol.scratch: High-level gemm inside each capture; SERIAL zeroing included
protocol.timing: Whole-call cold-L2 CUDA graph, gross events, no subtraction
protocol.correctness: Original FP64/probe oracle for every measured/warmup output
protocol.capture_call_checks: Three library warmups plus one capture per arm/cohort; these 24 outputs are not individually oracle-checked
protocol.between_arm_work: Input immutability check after each timed arm; cold-L2 eviction before each arm; FP64 oracles after all three

gate.selection: Retain P046; require correctness and >=5% whole-call cut against P046 in both fresh cohorts, plus >2% SERIAL-vs-SEPARATE cut; <=2% is inconclusive

limitations: No native compilation or GPU pass follows from CPU/mock tests.
SEPARATE compiles FP32 partial output; SERIAL compiles BF16 final output. Automatic AB/epilogue stages, shared layouts and resources may differ.
P046 vendor geometry and algorithm differ from both Quack arms; it is the real performance control, not a causal finalization-only control.
SM90 Quack defaults PDL on; the high-level call has no use_pdl override.
Private scratch supports sequential replay structurally; overlapping replay of one graph, independent concurrent kernels and persistent-grid liveness are unverified.
One canonical shape only; no nearby/tail shapes, official score or calibrated timing.
Upstream CuTe FFI converter patch needs contest eligibility review before any submission.
